description: This file appears to be a C header file defining interfaces and constants related to the 'rerere' feature in a version control system, likely Git. It declares structures, function prototypes, macros, and external variables used for managing recorded conflict resolutions.

methods.name: setup_rerere
methods.description: Initializes the rerere subsystem for a given repository, with configuration options supplied via a string list and an integer flag.

methods.name: repo_rerere
methods.description: Performs rerere-related operations on the repository, parameterized by an integer operation code.

methods.name: rerere_path
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path associated with a given conflict ID and file type, or the directory housing rerere files if 'file' is NULL.

methods.name: rerere_forget
methods.description: Removes recorded conflict resolution data for specified paths matching the pathspec.

methods.name: rerere_remaining
methods.description: Checks for remaining conflicts that need rerere resolution in the repository.

methods.name: rerere_clear
methods.description: Clears recorded rerere data for the specified paths.

methods.name: rerere_gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection on rerere cache data to free space.
